question: ______ take oath as the 50th Chief Justice of India on November 9, 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice D.Y. Chandrachud.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Justice D.Y. Chandrachud** is expected to take oath as the **50th Chief Justice of India **on **November 9, 2022.**
 
• Justice D.Y. Chandrachud is currently a judge of the Supreme Court of India and has been serving in this position since 201
